metadata.title: feat: implement dark/light mode theme toggle
metadata.author: vishu-bh

description:
## Summary
Implements dark/light mode theming for the React app with a toggle button in the header.

## Changes
- ✅ Add ThemeProvider with React Context API for theme management
- ✅ Create ThemeToggle component with Sun/Moon/Monitor icons
- ✅ Support three modes: light, dark, and system preference
- ✅ Persist theme preference to localStorage
- ✅ Add i18n translations for EN, ES, and PT-BR
- ✅ Integrate theme toggle in header between language switcher and user info
- ✅ Add comprehensive unit tests (16 passing, 2 skipped)
- ✅ Add localStorage mock to test setup

## Testing
- Unit tests: 16 passing, 2 skipped (timing-related in test env)
- Manual testing recommended in browser

## Files Changed
- `client/src/hooks/useTheme.tsx` (new)
- `client/src/components/ui/ThemeToggle.tsx` (new)
- `client/src/App.tsx` (modified)
- `client/src/components/layout/Header.tsx` (modified)
- `client/src/i18n/locales/*/common.json` (modified)
- `client/src/test/setup.ts` (modified)
- `client/src/hooks/useTheme.test.tsx` (new)
- `client/src/components/ui/ThemeToggle.test.tsx` (new)

## Notes
Dark mode CSS was already fully configured in `client/src/index.css` with `:root` (light) and `.dark` (dark) classes.

fix: add comprehensive dark mode support across all pages and components

- Fix LanguageSwitcher component with dark mode support
- Fix authentication pages (Login, ForgotPassword, ResetPassword, ChangePassword)
- Add dark:text-neutral-100 to all page headings
- Add dark:bg-neutral-700/800/900 to backgrounds
- Add dark:border-neutral-600/700 to borders
- Fix input fields with proper dark mode text and background colors
- Remove unused vi import from ThemeToggle.test.tsx
- Add non-null assertion to useTheme.test.tsx
- Format all files with Prettier

Theme persists in localStorage across sessions as requested.
